originality.rationale: Ulas--Żmija, arXiv:1904.03398, Section 6 Conjecture 6.6(4), explicitly proposes the relations for S_{4,2}; their proved valuations are for prime bases. The new mod-32 classification proves this specific conjecture and all three densities; neighboring composite-base work requiring ν2(m)>=2 excludes m=2. Exact claim, equivalent formulations and known general results were checked, with incomplete access to an adjacent 2023 paper recorded.
residual_risks: The full text of the relevant 2023 Żmija article could not be inspected; its available abstract does not demonstrate the quaternary theorem.
An unindexed earlier implicit derivation of the mod-32 identity cannot be ruled out; absolute priority is not certified.
The theorem treats only k=4,m=2; other colors and more general conjectures remain open.
